All these people have sought Allaah's protection and are Allaah's neighbours in his custody. When a man becomes the Ameer and the people (under his command) oppress each other, Allaah will take revenge from him if he does not give back to the oppressed what the oppressors had taken from them. This is just like the case when your neighbour's goat is taken away and you spend the entire day with swollen veins out of feeling for your neighbour. In the same way, Allaah also lends his support to His neighbours.'"
Hadhrat Raafi (RA) reports further, "It was a year later that Abu Bakr (RA) was made the Khalifah. I then rode off to meet him. I introduced myself as Raafi and reminded him where I had been his guide. When he confirmed that he remembered who I was, I said, 'You used to prevent me from becoming an Ameer and now you have mounted a much greater task as the Ameer of the entire Ummah of Muhammad ﷺ.' He replied, 'Indeed, because the one who does not enforce the Book of Allaah amongst the people shall earn the curse of Allaah." [^1]
The Sahabah (RA) Prefer Fighting Rather than Taking Command

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Sa'eed bin Amr bin Sa'eed bin Al Aas
blocks.text: Hadhrat Sa'eed bin Amr bin Sa'eed bin Al Aas narrates that his uncles Hadhrat Khaalid bin Sa'eed bin Al Aas (RA), Hadhrat Abaan bin Sa'eed bin Al Aas (RA) and Hadhrat Amr bin Sa'eed bin Al Aas (RA) all returned to Madinah from their posts (as governors of various districts) when they heard about the demise of Rasulullaah ﷺ. Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) said to them, "None are more qualified to be governors than those whom Rasulullaah ﷺ himself appointed (you should therefore return to your posts)." However, they replied, "We shall not command for anyone." They then returned to Shaam where all of them were martyred." [^2]
The Incident that Occurred between Hadhrat Umar (RA) and Hadhrat Abaan bin Sa'eed (RA) Concerning an Appointment to Command and Hadhrat Umar (RA) Dispatches Hadhrat Alaa bin Hadhrami (RA) to Bahrain

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Sa'eed bin Yarboo
blocks.text: Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Sa'eed bin Yarboo narrates that when Hadhrat Abaan bin Sa'eed (RA) returned to Madinah, Hadhrat Umar (RA) said to him, "You have no right to come here and leave your post without the permission of your leader, especially under the present circumstances (when people are revolting and the enemy is ready to pounce on us).
